topic: Updating signal levels and data cleanup
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main topics: updating signal levels and cleaning up data in Brazil VA.

**Signal Level Update:** The participants discussed setting a signal level for specific facilities (78, 27045, 27052) associated with company 7904. It was confirmed that the update needed to be applied at the company level rather than just the facility level. After initial technical issues regarding cache refresh and stage calibration were addressed, the signal levels were successfully updated.

**Brazil VA Data Cleanup:** Issues were identified concerning duplicate records in the Brazil VA dataset (`_brazil_va_2`), specifically where a single `frame_id` was associated with only one record when two different records were expected. The participants decided on a plan to handle this data discrepancy, favoring a full re-upload of the data (Option 1) rather than attempting complex point-by-point deduplication.

**Future Data Enhancements:** It was agreed that future iterations of the dataset should include speed and start/end coordinates.
decisions: Signal levels for facilities 78, 27045, and 27052 were updated at the company level (7904).
The Brazil VA data will be re-uploaded entirely to resolve duplicate record issues.
Future versions of the dataset must include speed and start/end coordinates.
action_items: Someone needs to review the SQL query used for extracting data from the database (for debugging purposes).
The full re-upload of the Brazil VA data should be completed by the end of the day.
